selected_full_reads.scope: Read the complete NVIDIA Technical Blog article covering supported OpenClaw, Hermes and LangChain Deep Agents harnesses; Nemotron and NeMo optimization; OpenShell controls for files, networks, credentials and tools; the chief-of-staff example; deployment options; and publisher and partner claim limitations.

Read the complete Mistral release covering the one-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts architecture, coding and cybersecurity benchmarks, three reasoning modes, guarded cyber testing, enterprise and sovereign deployment options, downloads, serving paths, pricing, license terms, partner quotations and publisher-reported limitations.

Read the complete OpenAI announcement covering the planned shared robots.txt signal for foundation-model training preferences, continued support for existing crawler-specific controls, the stated implementation timeline, participation in the IETF AI Preferences effort and the distinction between a future commitment and current enforcement.

Read the complete Microsoft Research article covering synthetic organizations derived from public occupational and company sources, three industry environments, the six-stage query pipeline, structural, contextual, behavioral and safety checks, internal composite results, cost claims and the need to validate synthetic-to-production transfer.

Read the complete OpenAI-hosted Intelligence Age essay covering the promoting, interleaving and layering scenarios; adoption from workers or executives; delegation scope; coordination seams; AI advising and monitoring; worker agency; red tape; firm size; pay disparity; and the authors’ explicit framing as illustrative scenarios rather than forecasts.

Read the complete LlamaIndex article covering the DPP 0.1 working draft, more than 140 rules for tables, forms, charts, diagrams, hidden or unreadable content and positions; installation in Claude and ChatGPT; the Apple sample page; the two 6,485 cell checks; preservation of (565); the eight-decision walkthrough; and draft-status limitations.
